Import any PDF and RaptiBooks rebuilds it as a phone-friendly book: text that fits your screen, chapters, tables and diagrams. Everything works offline.
PDF → Analyze → Extract → Reformat → Mobile book
Scanned pages have no text layer. OCR reads them in Bangla and English, offline.
Use OCR only for scanned pages or pages with broken text.
Read every page with OCR. Slower; useful when the text layer is wrong.

RaptiBooks turns PDFs into books that are comfortable to read on a phone. It detects chapters, headings, paragraphs, lists, tables and diagrams, removes page headers, footers and page numbers, and reads scanned pages with offline OCR (Bangla + English).\n\nFonts: Tiro Bangla and Hind Siliguri (SIL Open Font License). PDF engine: PdfBox-Android (Apache 2.0). OCR: Tesseract (Apache 2.0).
